text:
anya: Quick hit: quickstart README curl examples break on PowerShell; also found mixed env var names and ambiguous retry text. Getting onboarding tickets.

matt: Repro in pwsh — single quotes stop env var expansion. Failing example:

```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

lia: Suggest including POSIX and PowerShell variants and standardizing on REDWOOD_API_KEY across samples.

sam: Docs should list SDK retry defaults (Node: off, Python: 3, Go: 2) and link to a new "SDK retry policies" page.

anya: Agreed. Action: update README with both curl forms, align env vars, add changelog note on old var, and add retry defaults to troubleshooting.

devex-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/2600 and draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/333 (assigning @matt)

matt: I'll push the PR with examples + migration note today.
